They also will be encouraged to participate in the decision-making processes. Participation in workshops, lectures and occasional studio visits will contribute to the fellowship programme. Although the research project's initial outline will be provided by SRAL conservators, its ultimate direction and scope will be decided in close consultation with the fellow.
